sourceTitle: Lennox SL280DFNV installation instructions 508150-02 (04/2024), integrated control diagnostic codes
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
displayPattern: Seven-segment diagnostic LED on a Lennox SL280DFNV.
meaning: Soft lockout: recycles ran out, and the last recycle was due to the pressure switch opening.
causes: Pressure switch opened on the last recycle
Low pressure switch stuck closed on a heat call
High pressure switch closing problem on a heat call
Vent or combustion-air inducer restricted or not operating
diySteps: With the furnace off, look at the outdoor intake and exhaust terminations for snow, ice, leaves or a nest. Do not take the vent apart

Technician: check whether the low pressure switch is stuck closed on a heat call, check the high pressure switch closing on a heat call, measure operating pressure, and inspect the vent and the combustion-air inducer. The code clears when a heat call finishes successfully
proAdvice: E272 is a recycle lockout after the pressure switch opened. It is not E271 (retry lockout) and not E274 (limit-circuit recycle lockout). Do not jumper a pressure switch. Call a licensed HVAC technician if the terminations are clear and the code returns.
